rawDogDemographyFormat: Publisher JATS XML returned by manuscript URL, not PDF; archived exact XML gzip
transcriptionScope: Exact table cells; cat longevity and dog litter tables reviewed from primary article copies through web retrieval. Copyrighted full articles are not redistributed.
excluded: Combined breed categories; broad Husky; designer crosses; breed-standard midpoints; personality scores; model predictions; health-disorder prizes. Species observations never inherited by breeds.
biologyPolicy: Cohort statistics with explicit definitions and endpoint sample sizes where published; SD and IQR are not CI. Dog lifespan reported 95% CIs retained. Dog litter SEM retained and labelled as SEM.
survivalPolicy: Empirical Kaplan–Meier cohort medians with original 95% CI; no projection, fitted maximum or imputed biology. Cannot appear with other lifespan categories.
